_about: The method layer over #8's edge model (List 21, #199) — NOT a new vocabulary. #8 (EVOLUTION-DATA-MODEL) owns the edge shape {from, to, methodClass, trigger, conditions[], representation, status} and the methodClass enum; this fragment records the declaration discipline and per-class consumption semantics only. CLARIFICATION: the commissioning brief's 'exchange' class is #8's 'trade' (exchange between Rangers) — #8's names govern; renaming would fork one vocabulary into two homes. 'single-stage' is the ABSENCE of an edge (#8's schema forbids placeholder edges). Zero schema edits, zero vocabulary edits.
a9_fence: The pair-merge edges (Lonelily -> Pairbloom -> Twinvow) carry representation: 'OWNER_DECISION' in #8's data, with #103's flag standing. This package defines NO consumption semantics for pair-merge representation — cited, not resolved, not routed around.

bond.consumption: reads the bond/care facts (#39 family); battle expression of bond is #180's lane — evolution reads the facts, not the presentation
bond.instances: wave-1 C4 sourced trigger (design lane disclosures)

colony.consumption: line-specific, defined on the sheet; NO generic engine semantics asserted

form-shift.consumption: line-specific, defined on the sheet; NO generic engine semantics asserted
form-shift.instances: wave-1 C4 sourced trigger ('the dome gains the face')

growth.consumption: stage progression itself; trigger stays null until the canon lock sets numbers (#197)

item.consumption: item consumed from #31's layer via #91's evolution-items family; the edge's trigger names the item id
item.instances: none in canon yet (class exists, edges don't — #8)

level.consumption: threshold read against the individual's derived level (#178)
level.instances: Gen 1 core's 29 edges in src/data/core/evolutions.json — structured already, mapped by #8, never re-encoded

place.consumption: reads the individual's current area state (#7)
place.instances: none asserted (#8: candidate shape for habitat-locked lines)

trade.consumption: fires INSIDE #168's transfer protocol as part of the exchange completing — never a field action on a kept Mochi; #168's record semantics untouched (the keeper seat rewrites; the evolved individual is the same individual)
trade.instances: none in canon yet (class exists, edges don't — #8)

declaration: per EDGE, on the sheet's prose Evolution field — the prose is the record (#8's fields-only rule); the edge is derived from it at coding time (evolution-edges.wave1.json: 64 wave-1 edges parsed from the sheets). A 3-stage line declares two methods; they may differ per edge.
numbers_fence: Trigger values are null across wave-1 by design. A declared method with a null trigger is a complete declaration awaiting the lock act (#197), not a gap in the sheet.
open_register: any line whose sheet prose leaves its method ambiguous (per-line data-lane reading)
generic colony/form-shift semantics if canon ever needs them
A9 pair-merge representation — OWNER DECISION (#103's flag, carried verbatim)
show_lane_mirror: In the show, a method is BIOGRAPHY, never a trigger (autonomous-action doctrine): the bond/place/item may be the moment's MEANING; no Ranger pulls a method like a lever and no script invokes one as a mechanic.
